# Paired comparison with the baseline (generated by scripts/analyse.py; do not edit)

Unit = start/goal pair. Success: mean paired difference with 95% bootstrap interval over pairs; verdict by the pre-registered rule (at least 10 points and interval excludes 0). Time/path: pairs where both succeeded; rule: interval excludes 0 and size above 5% of baseline. Per-world rows are suggestive only (20 pairs). A-C is the original design; A-D includes the post-hoc world D.
